Generate tidyverse Code for Categorical Recoding and Discrepancy Crosswalks

Source: R/codegen.R
sv_code_recode.Rd

Generate tidyverse Code for Categorical Recoding and Discrepancy Crosswalks

Usage

sv_code_recode(
  df_name,
  col,
  crosswalk,
  default = NULL,
  method = c("case_when", "case_match", "fct_recode"),
  pipe = FALSE,
  lazy = FALSE
)

Arguments

df_name

Name of the data frame.

col

Column name to recode.

crosswalk

Mapping between source and target values. Can be:

  • A data.frame with source values in column 1 and target values in column 2.

  • A named character vector (names = source values, values = target values).

  • A named list where names are target values and elements are vectors of source values.

default

Fallback value for unmatched records. If NULL, omitted. If equal to col, emits unquoted column name .default = <col>.

method

Recoding function: "case_when" (dplyr, the default), "case_match" (dplyr; deprecated in dplyr 1.2.0, kept for older pipelines) or "fct_recode" (forcats).

pipe

Logical; if TRUE, uses pipe syntax df %>% dplyr::mutate(...).

lazy

Logical; TRUE for a table that lives in arrow or duckdb. case_when() then closes with a TRUE ~ <col> arm instead of .default = <col>, which arrow cannot take.

Value

A character string of R code.
